projects.title: CogniSynth
projects.desc: GraphRAG pipeline for research papers, with a Neo4j knowledge graph, two-pass vision enrichment of figures, and claim checking.
details: The owner describes PDF parsing with Docling, entity extraction with GLiNER and a Groq vision model, and canonical entity deduplication.
The described retrieval pipeline combines graph and text evidence, with BGE-M3 embeddings and BGE-Reranker-V2-M3.
The described answer checks compare extracted claims against retrieved text. They do not guarantee factual correctness.

projects.title: LuminaNotes
projects.desc: Vision-first OCR and academic summarization system. Processes PDFs, PPTX, and videos into Notion-ready study guides.
details: Book_processor.py configures meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct for vision extraction and summarization.
The project converts slides to PDF with LibreOffice, extracts page images with Poppler, and transcribes video audio with Whisper.
Entity checks compare names and other extracted entities with OCR text. Entity presence does not validate relationships, quantities, omissions, or factual accuracy.

projects.title: Invoice Automation
projects.desc: n8n workflow for structured data extraction from multi-format invoices using Vision-Language Models.
details: The owner describes an email-triggered n8n workflow, a FastAPI extraction service, and structured vendor, date, currency, total and line-item fields.
The described validation compares line-item amounts with invoice totals and routes validation failures for manual review.
No public implementation, accuracy dataset, processing-time measurement, or vendor privacy agreement is available in this repository.

projects.title: Islamic Source Finder
projects.desc: Multi-modal semantic retrieval system for religious texts, supporting text, image, audio, and video queries.
details: The project describes text embeddings with sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and a ChromaDB vector store.
OCR and Whisper transcription turn image and audio/video queries into searchable text.
Retrieved passages help a visitor locate sources. Similarity does not establish authenticity, doctrinal correctness, or an authoritative religious judgment. No latency benchmark is published here.

projects.title: AI Portfolio Engine
projects.desc: This site's RAG chatbot: Qdrant and Groq over project documentation, with inspectable source passages. It validates requests and citation quotes, classifies conversations, and applies injection-pattern filters.
details: The embedding model is sentence-transformers/all-minilm-l6-v2. Qdrant stores 384-dimensional cosine vectors named content_vector.
The API retrieves up to five passages and retains project, section, chunk ID, document version and similarity score. Follow-up queries use bounded recent user context.
Groq generation uses qwen/qwen3.8-27b and classification uses openai/gpt-oss-safeguard-20b. Configured IDs do not prove account access.
Selected citations must reference retrieved labels and include a verbatim quote. Validation proves quote provenance, not semantic entailment.
The API has a 24-second cancellable request budget, eight-second provider timeouts and no Groq retries. Browser requests have a 30-second deadline.

Production requires an atomic shared Redis quota. Defaults are ten requests per IP per minute, sixty requests globally per minute, and eight concurrent leases. Missing store configuration returns 503.
Corpus refresh builds and verifies a replacement collection before switching the portfolio-live alias, retaining old collections for rollback.
